subject: english
question:
Choose the correct words to complete the sentence:

In the midst of the (1) __________ forest, the hiker suddenly realized that he had lost his (2) __________ and had no sense of (3) __________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"dense"** means something that is closely compacted in substance. (घना)

 
 
• **Example: **The **dense **forest was almost impenetrable.
 
 
 
• The word **"map"** refers to a diagrammatic representation of an area of land or sea showing physical features. (नक्शा)
 
 
• **Example: **He used a **map** to navigate through the unfamiliar city.
 
 
 
• The word **"direction"** refers to the course along which someone or something moves. (दिशा)
 
 
• **Example: **The compass helped them find the right** direction.**<
